meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询癌症依赖图谱数据，发现肿瘤靶点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在癌症研究中使用DepMap数据筛选基因依赖或药物敏感性。
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer dependency map data to discover tumor targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze cancer gene dependencies or drug sensitivity data from DepMap.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以查询癌症依赖图谱(DepMap)数据库,获取癌细胞系的基因依赖评分(CRISPR Chronos)、药物敏感性数据,并产出按癌症类型、突变状态整理的依赖分析结果。
howto.when: 当用户要求查询基因依赖评分、寻找合成致死基因、验证肿瘤药靶等时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下 KRAS 基因在肺癌细胞系中的依赖评分
say.note: 返回各细胞系的 Chronos 评分及癌症类型标注

say.text: 在 BRCA1 突变的细胞系中,哪些基因比野生型更必需?
say.note: 对比突变与野生型细胞系的基因效应差异

say.text: 列出与 KRAS 共必需的基因
say.note: 按相关性排序返回共必需基因列表

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can query the DepMap database for CRISPR Chronos gene dependency scores, drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles, producing dependency analyses grouped by cancer type or mutation status.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about gene dependency scores, synthetic lethality, drug target validation, or similar analyses.

say_en.text: Check the dependency score of KRAS in lung cancer cell lines.
say_en.note: Returns Chronos scores annotated with cancer type

say_en.text: Which genes are more essential in BRCA1-mutant cell lines than in wild-type?
say_en.note: Compares gene effects between mutant and wild-type lines
Returns top co-essential genes ranked by correlation
